name: seam
summary: Mac app that turns the notch into a Dynamic Island for on-device dictation, music, a focus timer and Claude Code status.
description: seam is a native macOS utility that turns the MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island-style control center. Features listed by the maker include on-device voice-to-text dictation into any app, music controls, calendar, a focus timer, battery status, and a notification when Claude Code finishes.
